title: Next.js & the Network
description: What crosses the wire in a Next.js 16 app, and who decides. Where each piece of code runs — Server Components, Server Actions, Route Handlers — and what that means for auth; the HTTP caching and compression headers every response carries, and which layer wins when two set them; Next's own Cache Components model (use cache, cacheLife, cacheTag, updateTag) and what changed from Next 14/15; and streaming with Suspense, where the status code is fixed at the first byte. Each unit closes on the production traps that pass every local check.
